scope: Only reviewed genuinely improved restored candidates on unchanged historical coarse grid. Stop on definite proximity FAIL before orientation; otherwise unchanged coarse orientation. No automatic fine grid or all-nine rerun.
sampling_parameters: Literal inherited sampling protocol numerical allowances, primary allowance, cell construction and native patch/collider boundary distance definitions. No post-candidate fitting.
orientation_parameters: Literal inherited orientation protocol inspect_orientation eligibility, tie safeguards, normal definitions, strata and direction state deadzone. Orientation remains unresolved on continuous cells.
range_policy: Physical source URDF bound ±1e-9; captured scene bound allowed only its own source-URDF decimal representation difference +1e-9, while strict scene overflow logged separately. No target clipping, no preflight acceptance claim.
anchor_policy: Original root quaternion stays bitwise identical. New palm position = original source native wrist world position + declared per-grasp world displacement. Actual floating forearm root includes joint-dependent wrist compensation. Independently compare sourceURDF q-relative palm/task geometry transformed by original operator R to full captured scene at declared translated anchor.
candidate_fallback_policy: All six source candidate rows are bound. Retained pooled fallbacks are NOT_RUN by this audit; only eligible changed restored rows may be staged and measured.
limitations: Conditional closest-query arithmetic assumptions are inherited; not a formal arithmetic error certificate.
Individual-collider surface distances may include buried interfaces, while orientation excludes buried nearest features. No global accessible contact boundary proof.
Native patches and target morphology differ. Strict band criteria may be infeasible for all cases; cannot loosen current frozen rule to get pass.

Poor native poses and added/lost proximity retained; lower penetration or successful lifts are not mapping acceptance.

candidate_domain_policy: Original physical/trust/source-reach domains unchanged plus exact endpoint-local restoration trust box, no added endpoint allowance.

A definite primary-allowance same-part proximity lower bound causes strictFAIL and skips orientation explicitly NOT_RUN. Otherwise original orientation runs once.
